panels.description: Selected Grafana time range, grouped by final event risk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT risk_level AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM security_event WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY FIELD(risk_level, 'CRITICAL', 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW')

panels.title: Events by risk level

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.category AS category, SUM(d.match_count) AS detections FROM security_event_detection d JOIN security_event e ON e.id = d.security_event_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.detected_at) GROUP BY d.category ORDER BY detections DESC

SELECT d.entity_type AS entity_type, SUM(d.match_count) AS detections FROM security_event_detection d JOIN security_event e ON e.id = d.security_event_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.detected_at) GROUP BY d.entity_type ORDER BY detections DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT d.rule_id AS rule_id, SUM(d.match_count) AS detections FROM security_event_detection d JOIN security_event e ON e.id = d.security_event_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.detected_at) GROUP BY d.rule_id ORDER BY detections DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT status AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM security_event WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY status
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(detected_at, '5m'), risk_level AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM security_event WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY 1, risk_level ORDER BY 1

panels.description: OPEN or INVESTIGATING events older than this visibility threshold. Alerts use risk-specific 1/4/24/72-hour thresholds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_id, detected_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, detected_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AS unresolved_hours, risk_level, status, source_service, event_name, assigned_to, masked_excerpt FROM security_event WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING') AND detected_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL ${unresolved_hours:raw} HOUR ORDER BY detected_at ASC LIMIT 200
